lines.text: Damascus has become a heap of ruins, and the forsaken cities of Aroer will be left to the flocks.
The fortress will disappear from Ephraim, and Jacob's splendor will fade like grain gleaned in the Valley of Hinnom.
Gleanings will remain like a beaten olive tree, and men will look to their Maker, not to their altars.
Because they forgot the God of their salvation, their harvest will vanish on the day of famine and incurable pain.
The raging nations flee when rebuked, and before morning they are no more.
